name: ensemble_v14
information: v14 = v12 stacking pipeline with two LightGBM models retrained on added exogenous inputs, plus corrections fitted on local out-of-fold residuals (nested, date-blocked). No leaderboard score is read or stored. v14e = v14 + the entries below, which rest on realised facts of the evaluation period (allowed by the organisers) and on ridership before the cutoff only; they cannot be validated on any fold.

extras.name: SSG 랜더스페셜 매치 '최광야구 1429' (23,000석 매진, 17:30 시작)
extras.basis: Held and sold out (press of 2026-11-05). v12/v13 treat the day as an ordinary Saturday (21h: 66). Crowd leaving by this station taken from the home-game relation of the training period (boardings in the two hours after the end = 0.263 x attendance + 204, i.e. about 6,300 for 23,000) and from the same event a year earlier (2025-10-24, 18:00 start, 21,000+ tickets: 391 / 5,279 / 1,140 boardings at 20 / 21 / 22h). The end time is not published; the three scenarios shift it between 20:20 and 21:10 and the forecast is their mean in log space.

extras.name: PLAVE World Tour [KEEP IT MANIC] in Incheon, 문학 주경기장 (토)

scenarios.note: leaving crowd peaks in the 21h cell
peaks in the 22h cell (19:00 start, about three hours)

extras.basis: Held as announced (19:00, report of 2026-09-15: about three hours, venue filled). All nine earlier main-stadium concert days before the cutoff have 6,131-10,189 boardings in the peak hour (geometric mean 7,324; hour before 429, hour after 847). v12/v13 have 548 / 695 / 248 at 21 / 22 / 23h. Weight 0.8 on the scenario mean and 0.2 on the existing forecast because the crowd of a first stadium show is not published.

extras.name: PLAVE World Tour [KEEP IT MANIC] in Incheon, 문학 주경기장 (일)
2026 인천송도국제마라톤 (08:00 출발, 인천대 송도캠퍼스)
extras.basis: The 2025 race (2025-09-28) gave 713 and 746 boardings at 10h and 11h against 242 and 261 on the neighbouring Sundays (x2.9). The retrained model of v14 already raises these two hours by about 30 %; x1.4 on top brings the forecast to roughly 55 % of the 2025 log effect (one earlier race only).

summer_leave.name: 여름 집단휴가 2주 (평일 7/27~8/7)
summer_leave.basis: Weekday boardings fell in the week holding 1 August and the following week in every year of the daily card data (nine years, mean -0.09 and -0.07 log against mid-July and late August); the mean of the other years reproduced the 2025 fall of our own stations (-0.100 vs -0.107, -0.076 vs -0.075). v14 forecasts -0.042 and -0.068 for 2026 (four industrial stations -0.09 and -0.14 against -0.30 and -0.27 in 2025). Per station and hour group, half of the difference between the 2025 fall and the fall v14 already forecasts is applied, only where 2025 was deeper. Which of the two weeks is deeper in 2026 is not known, so both get the same shift.
